description.value: Family-run campground in the Monashee Mountain foothills on Highway 6 near Cherryville, with gold panning on active placer mining claims as its signature draw; flush toilets and showers run May long weekend through Thanksgiving, with dry camping available year-round.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and richly detailed. Key amenity evidence comes from the About page ('coin-operated hot showers, flushing toilets, covered BBQ area, picnic table and fire pit' at every site, gravity-fed mountain water system, free wi-fi at front office only) and the FAQ/booking platform confirms online reservations are accepted. Phone 250.540.4116 matches OSM +1-250-540-4116; however the contact page lists no 'info@GoldPannerCampground.com' address (only bookings@, events@, retail@), and the address on the website ('423 Highway 6') drops the 'B' unit and 'East' qualifier present in OSM.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '423 B East Highway 6' but the website contact page and FAQ both list '423 Highway 6', omitting the 'B' unit designator and 'East' qualifier.
OSM email 'info@GoldPannerCampground.com' does not appear on the website's contact page; current emails are bookings@campgoldpanner.com, events@campgoldpanner.com, and retail@campgoldpanner.com.

Business is under new management as of Spring 2026 with a new booking platform; prior reservations were not transferred, indicating a significant operational transition that may affect data reliability during the transition period.
Wi-fi is currently only available at the front office building (Gold Panner Apothecary); campground-wide wi-fi is listed as in progress.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, fee-based campground with confirmed amenities (showers, potable water, covered shelter, online reservations) in a scenic Monashee Mountains location on Highway 6 — a clear benefit to touring cyclists passing through the North Okanagan.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Gold Panner Apothecary in the front office building provides free wi-fi; Telus cellular service is reported to be reliable across most of the property.

wow_evidence: coin-operated hot showers, flushing toilets, covered BBQ area... gravity-fed mountain water system
